name: sutradhar
description: WhatsApp-native service operations agent for local service businesses

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @sutradhar/contracts && concurrently -n api,dashboard -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @sutradhar/api" "npm run dev -w @sutradhar/dashboard"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @sutradhar/contracts && npm run build -w @sutradhar/api && npm run build -w @sutradhar/dashboard
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @sutradhar/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @sutradhar/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @sutradhar/api && npm run typecheck -w @sutradhar/dashboard
scripts.test: npm run build -w @sutradhar/contracts && npm run test -w @sutradhar/api && npm run test -w @sutradhar/dashboard
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build -w @sutradhar/contracts && npm run test:coverage -w @sutradhar/api && npm run test -w @sutradhar/dashboard
scripts.check: npm run verify:clean-repo && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run build
